Migratory freshwater fish populations have dropped 81% globally since the 1970s. Nearly all (97%) of the 58 fish […]

articles.title: PM Modi to inaugurate ₹169 crore RBI data centre in Odisha on October 25
articles.summary: According to the tentative itinerary shared by the chief secretary's office, PM Modi is scheduled to land at Biju Patnaik International Airport here around 4.30 pm aboard a special Indian Air Force aircraft.

articles.title: Odisha CM Majhi holds talks with POSCO, JSW on proposed 6 MTPA steel plant
articles.summary: POSCO India head S L Chun, the company's Mumbai office managing director Jacy Kim, and JSW Group chairman Sajjan Jindal attended the meeting.

articles.title: Dalmia Bharat Foundation opens skill development centre in UP’s Hardoi, to train 360 youth annually
articles.summary: The centre will offer courses in healthcare assistance, data entry and electrical work, with the foundation reporting a job placement or self-employment rate of over 70% among trainees in Uttar Pradesh.

articles.title: Mizoram CM launches ₹5 crore development projects at Champhai College
articles.summary: Highlighting development initiatives in Champhai district, the chief minister referred to the working women's hostel at Tlangrawt, improvement in district jail infrastructure, road widening and the New Champhai Sports Complex.

articles.title: EAM Jaishankar and Azerbaijan FM discuss connectivity, North-South transport corridors
articles.summary: External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar met Azerbaijan's Foreign Minister Jeyhun Bayramov and President Ilham Aliyev in Baku to boost bilateral, economic, and regional ties. He also conveyed greetings from the Indian leadership, while other officials advanced ongoing diplomatic engagements.

articles.title: Finance Minister chairs 30th FSDC meeting amid focus on financial stability
articles.summary: Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman on Friday chaired the 30th meeting of the Financial Stability and Development Council (FSDC) in New Delhi, with the Reserve Bank of India Governor, heads of financial sector regulators and senior government officials in attendance.

articles.title: Govt to bear 'expensive' certification costs for micro, small exporters under EPM: Piyush Goyal
articles.summary: India's Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal announced that the government will bear certification costs for exporters. This initiative particularly aids micro and small enterprises facing high compliance costs with European regulations.

articles.title: Uttarakhand Cabinet approves changes in UCC Rules, 24 other proposals
articles.summary: Uttarakhand Cabinet convened and approved 25 proposals, addressing key issues related to education, tourism, and civil code. Changes in the approval process for road and bridge construction works were implemented to enhance efficiency.

articles.title: The toxic tyre chemical no one is measuring
articles.summary: Every time a vehicle moves, its tyres shed tiny particles. Some of these particles carry a chemical that, in the U.S., was found killing salmon in urban streams after rain. India is selling more vehicles than ever before, yet experts say there is no data on how much of this chemical reaches the country’s rivers. […]

articles.title: How Columbus’ voyages accelerated the homogenisation of Earth’s biodiversity [Commentary]
articles.summary: Christopher Columbus was a legendary 15th-century Italian explorer whose “misadventures” opened the way for large-scale biogeographical homogenisation. Over the past 500 years, since Columbus first sailed west across the Atlantic Ocean to reach the “New World”, Earth has witnessed unprecedented cross-boundary human movement and the exchange of living organisms. articles.title: Adani sought prior approval for proposed Vizhinjam port stake transfer, says Keralam CM
articles.summary: Replying to an unstarred question in the Assembly recently, Keralam Chief Minister V D Satheesan said Adani Vizhinjam Port Private Limited (AVPPL) had submitted an application to the government seeking prior approval for the proposed transfer of its existing 49 per cent shareholding.

articles.title: UPEIDA opens industrial plot allotment scheme across 8 UP manufacturing, logistics clusters
articles.summary: Land premiums range from ₹3,800 to ₹11,470 per sq metre; applications opened on October 16 through the Nivesh Mitra portal

articles.title: NHAI deploys sprinklers, anti-smog guns to curb dust pollution across Delhi-NCR
articles.summary: NHAI has deployed around 60 water sprinklers and tankers, 14 anti-smog guns, 23 mechanical road-sweeping machines (MRSMs) and two tractor-mounted broomers.

articles.title: Maharashtra CM inaugurates three Mumbai flyovers, targets 50-60 minute cross-city travel
articles.summary: Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis was speaking after virtually inaugurating three new flyovers -- the railway overbridges at Sion in the island city and Vidyavihar in the eastern suburbs, and a flyover on the Goregaon-Mulund Link Road (GMLR) in the western suburbs.
